verdict.rationale: Restate documents durable timers with delayed messages (the 'delay' part of the story) and idempotency-key deduplication of incoming events, which collapses duplicate triggers. Per-scope concurrency limits shape traffic from noisy streams. Debounce or batching would have to be hand-built from these primitives plus Kafka-driven handlers or a cancel-and-restart pattern. missing for 10: a native debounce primitive, a native batching/windowing primitive for collapsing event streams, and independent hands-on corroboration.
